objects: attacking or blocking creature with positive-integer printed Bushido
state_reads: current typed Bushido instances and printed values
timing: all multiplayer block declarations finish before triggers are placed
choices: each controller orders simultaneous triggers through the ordinary APNAP trigger subsystem
apnap: all occurrences from one sealed transition are grouped once in APNAP order
layers: the resolving +N/+N modifier is an identity-locked layer 7c effect until end of turn
copy: only trusted typed current ability fragments participate
control_change: the source controller at trigger creation controls the triggered ability
zone_change: a changed source logical identity receives no modifier
source_leaves: the ability resolves but has no affected object after its source changes zones

known_blockers: zero, variable, conditional, and rules-text-equivalent Bushido wording remains unsupported
granted, copied, and face-down Bushido requires trusted typed ability fragments
